name: pearl
description: Search and match Pearl places, get taste-aware recommendations, check table availability, and confirm visit edits, saved places, and private trip plans.

interface.longDescription: Eligible Pearl Reserve and Elite members can discover and compare places, explore their taste profile and activity summaries, check table availability, and confirm visit or saved-place changes on supported connections. Creating private trips and changing their stops requires Pearl Reserve or above, including Pearl Elite. Features depend on the connection and permissions; availability does not book a table.
defaultPrompt: Show me the best new and coming-soon places in New York.
Recommend Pearl hotels in Paris based on my taste profile.
Find my friend Maya on Pearl and show my pending friend requests.
